steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application name as 'Simple NotePad' and generate the package identifier 'com.simplenotepad.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Establish build configurations to map Java 17, Gradle 8.5, and Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2 definitions.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Formulate the AndroidManifest.xml file specifying the package namespace, base system theme, launcher activity, and app icon configuration.

steps.title: Design Core Layout Structure
steps.description: Construct the XML layout framework using linear arrangements and scrolls to containerize our note editor and tap counter widgets.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Initialization
steps.description: Author the standard Java-compatible MainActivity skeleton defining class imports and fundamental onCreate methods.

steps.title: Construct Note Storage Logic
steps.description: Write logic utilizing SharedPreferences to read and save user typed content persistent across app relaunches.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Tap Counter Logic
steps.description: Incorporate state-tracking logic to handle screen clicks, incremental count updates, and resets.

steps.title: Bind UI Event Listeners
steps.description: Implement standard click listener overrides for Save, Clear, Tap, and Reset actions utilizing anonymous inner classes.

steps.title: Provide User Feedback Loops
steps.description: Embed standard Toast notification flows to alert users about saved entries, cleared notes, and counter operations.

steps.title: Validate Namespace and Environment Settings
steps.description: Conduct syntax layout checks on all XML elements and ensure strict Java 8 compilation compatibility.

steps.title: Building Simple NotePad
steps.description: Run standard command to build compile targets, package code, and output the debug APK.
